newsitem.title: USA: Versar acquires 53 pct of Science Management.
newsitem.headline: Versar acquires 53 pct of Science Management.

text.p: Versar Inc said Monday it has acquired a majority interest in Science Management Corp SMCG.OB from private investors. Versar said it acquired 53 percent of SMC's outstanding common stock and all the outstanding preferred stock for cash. Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company said it plans to propose a merger to obtain the remaining SMC common shares for newly issued Versar common shares, and in the case of small shareholdings, for cash.

SMC is a diversified professional services firm providing consulting, process engineering, information technology and environmental services to commercial and industrial clients. It had revenues of about $25.7 million in 1996.
Versar said the acquisition of Science Management Corp will increase earnings on a per share basis and is an important first step in its expansion and diversification program.
Versar is an environmental consulting and infrastructure management company which provides scientific, technical and services to industry and government.
